invariants.title: The journal is a derivation, never a posting: an export reads it and changes nothing.
Money is integer minor units; every export balances, per entry and in total.
One currency per hand-over; a period holding more than one is refused until a currency is named.
An export is refused while an account the period uses lacks the mapping the format needs, naming it.
Every hand-over records format, period, counts, control totals, a hash and the actor, and keeps the exact file.
Omitting the period start continues from the last hand-over in that format.
Re-exporting a period already sent is allowed and always visible, naming the earlier hand-over.
The chart is theirs: codes and names come from the accountant, never invented.
Every write is a logged act with an actor; refusals are logged too.
